name: sticky-content-wrapper
description: Split-screen marketing tour that pins a viewport while copy steps through headings, lists, and a CTA and the paired image scales and swaps.
purpose: Keeps one product claim on screen while proof, rooms, or steps change beside it, without leaving semantic tokens.
bestFor: feature walkthroughs with a still per beat
avoidFor: short pages with a single image
forms or dense docs where pinning would hide the next section
